children: Dogwood Therapeutics reported that Halneuron met the primary endpoint in a Phase 2b trial for chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain, with significantly more patients achieving pain reduction than on placebo.
At Week 4, 23.3% of Halneuron patients achieved at least a 50% pain reduction versus 9.2% on placebo (p=0.003).
The 239-patient trial also showed significant improvements in neuropathic pain, numbness and tingling, quality of life, and pain interference.
Pain reduction was observed whether patients used Halneuron alone or alongside background pain medications.
More than 95% of participants completed the study; treatment-emergent adverse events were reported in 90.0% of Halneuron patients and 54.6% of placebo patients.
